canonical_example.translation: We need to shut the windows before we leave.

canonical_example.text: Tuvimos que cerrar el negocio porque no era rentable.
canonical_example.translation: We had to close the business because it wasn't profitable.

canonical_example.text: No sabía que ese restaurante había cerrado.
canonical_example.translation: I didn't know that restaurant had closed.

canonical_example.text: Alguna gente mayor es muy cerrada en cuanto a convivir antes de casarse.
canonical_example.translation: Some old people are very closed-minded about living together before getting married.

canonical_example.text: Sociedades aisladas muchas veces son cerradas respecto a personas de afuera.
canonical_example.translation: Isolated societies are often unwelcoming when it comes to outsiders.

canonical_example.text: La asociación de padres es un grupo muy cerrado y los nuevos nos sentimos incómodos.
canonical_example.translation: The PTA is a very closed group and those of us who are new feel awkward.

canonical_example.text: Aunque no tengan un acento muy cerrado, apenas los entiendo.
canonical_example.translation: Even if they don't have a strong accent, I hardly understand them.

canonical_example.text: Casi pierdo control del coche en esa curva cerrada.
canonical_example.translation: I nearly lost control of the car on that tight corner.

canonical_example.text: Los días cerrados con lluvia me deprimen.
canonical_example.translation: Overcast rainy days make me depressed.

canonical_example.text: En noches cerradas no verás estrellas en el cielo.
canonical_example.translation: On very dark nights, you won't see any stars in the sky.

canonical_example.text: Cierra herméticamente el tarro.
canonical_example.translation: Close the jar tightly.

canonical_example.text: Cerraron el acuerdo de cooperación el 23 de marzo.
canonical_example.translation: The cooperation agreement was concluded on March 23rd.

canonical_example.text: Puedes cerrar el gas en la válvula de cierre principal.
canonical_example.translation: ​You can turn the gas off at the main shut-off valve.

canonical_example.text: Cierra la luz y vete a dormir.
canonical_example.translation: Turn off the light and go to sleep.

canonical_example.text: ¿Crees que acabarán cerrando la discoteca?
canonical_example.translation: Do you think they'll end up shutting down the nightclub?

canonical_example.text: ¿Sabes a qué hora cierra la tienda?
canonical_example.translation: Do you know what time the store closes?

canonical_example.text: Cerramos a las 8 pm.
canonical_example.translation: We shut at 8 pm.

canonical_example.text: La mayoría de las cortaduras pequeñas cierran rápidamente.
canonical_example.translation: Most minor cuts heal quickly.

canonical_example.text: Me corté la mano pero la herida ya cerró.
canonical_example.translation: I cut my hand, but the wound already closed up.

canonical_example.text: ¿Cuándo cerró la fábrica?
canonical_example.translation: When did the factory shut down?

canonical_example.text: No me cierro a nuevas oportunidades.
canonical_example.translation: I'm not closed to new opportunities.

canonical_example.text: El cielo se está cerrando. Espero que no llueva.
canonical_example.translation: The sky is becoming overcast. I hope it doesn't rain.

canonical_example.text: El sol se pone y se cierra la noche.
canonical_example.translation: The sun sets and night falls.

canonical_example.text: Ciérrate la chaqueta que hace frío.
canonical_example.translation: Zip up your jacket; it's cold.

canonical_example.text: Debes cerrarte bien la chamarra antes de salir.
canonical_example.translation: You should button your jacket up properly before going out.

canonical_example.text: La herida no se cierra sola y por eso hay que suturarla.
canonical_example.translation: The wound isn't healing on its own so we'll need to stitch it up.

canonical_example.text: La herida se cerrará poco a poco.
canonical_example.translation: The wound will gradually close up.

canonical_example.text: Cada vez que se lo comento, se cierra y cambia de tema.
canonical_example.translation: Every time I mention it to her, she shuts down and changes the subject.

canonical_example.text: Seguro que hay más planetas que albergan vida en el universo aparte de la Tierra.
canonical_example.translation: I am sure there are more planets with life in the universe apart from the Earth.

canonical_example.text: En el universo de la filosofía existen muchísimas corrientes de pensamiento.
canonical_example.translation: In the world of philosophy, there are many currents of thought.

canonical_example.text: Puedo sentir el latido de mi corazón en los dedos.
canonical_example.translation: I can feel my heartbeat in my fingers.

canonical_example.text: Sentí mucho frío mientras esperaba que me rescataran de la montaña.
canonical_example.translation: I felt really cold while I waited to be rescued from the mountain.

canonical_example.text: No me creía capaz de sentir pena por mi ex después de todo lo que pasó.
canonical_example.translation: I didn't think I was capable of feeling sorry for my ex after everything that happened.

canonical_example.text: Ya hace unos meses que me siento bajo de ánimo.
canonical_example.translation: I've been feeling down for a few months now.

canonical_example.text: El niño se sintió porque no pudo hacer lo que quería.
canonical_example.translation: The kid got upset because he couldn't do what he wanted to.

canonical_example.text: ¿Sentiste el estruendo?
canonical_example.translation: Did you hear that loud noise?

canonical_example.text: ¿No sientes esa peste?
canonical_example.translation: Can't you smell that stench?

canonical_example.text: Cuando estaba embarazada, a veces sentía un sabor metálico en la boca.
canonical_example.translation: When I was pregnant, sometimes I tasted a metallic taste in my mouth.

canonical_example.text: Sentimos mucho su pérdida.
canonical_example.translation: We're very sorry for your loss.

canonical_example.text: Siento mucho lo de tu empleo. Espero que te salga otra oportunidad pronto.
canonical_example.translation: I'm really sorry about your job. I hope something else comes up soon.
